descriptionMarkdown:
This is a compact design for a perfect 1000 science per minute mega base.  I wanted to make a compact base that I could copy in other locations when I decide to go more than 1KSPM.

The North side is the basic science setup... Smelting/Electronics/Various Items/Science Factories.

The South Side is the same setup but for the space science.

I used some designs and blueprints that I found from various places... Reddit, factorioprints.
title: 1KSPM Mega Base Compact
